content.comment_body: Can anyone provide guidance on a [product_name]? When I write my logic and simulate it in [product_name] it works as expected. However, after uploading, the scaling or displayed values on my text message interface change. I’m using an analog input and a PI component to adjust a counter, which updates the setpoint value shown as text. It simulates correctly, but on the actual device, the value unexpectedly jumps to 65870.
Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum! Please avoid posting the same issue multiple times. You already have a related question here: [url]

Thank you for the warm welcome, and I apologize as I am new. I only later realized this issue might belong in a different category and wasn't sure if it's related to software or hardware. I'm learning through trial and error and didn’t expect such quick responses here. I appreciate the help and am eager to learn, as well as support others in the future.
An image typically doesn’t help much with troubleshooting. Please upload your program as a zip file for review. Regards, [user_name]
This issue has been resolved in the following topic: [url]

This thread is closed because the question was posted twice. The other thread, titled 'Simulation not same result as running [product_name],' is available in the [product_name] software section. Best regards, [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: A user detected a mismatch between simulation results in [product_name] and how the values appeared on actual hardware. Analog processing and text message displays worked correctly during simulation, but showed unexpected results once deployed, causing uncertainty about the source—software or hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that outputs from simulation and actual hardware should match, especially for handling analog values and displaying text messages.
